# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes target the latest release, including `0.x` versions; backports are not guaranteed.
Before the first release, report against `main`.

## Report a vulnerability

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/pacoricci/BaboReborn/security/advisories/new).
If unavailable, open an issue requesting a private contact, without vulnerability details.

Include the release or commit, reproduction steps, deployment conditions,
impact, and a minimal proof of concept when useful. Remove credentials and
private player data. Test only with the system owner's permission.

Coordinate disclosure with maintainers. No response or remediation SLA is promised.
